description: This file implements the WebSocket protocol handshake processor for version HyBi 00, including request validation, header processing, challenge-response generation, and handshake response sending.

classes.name: Handshaker
classes.description: Handles the WebSocket handshake process for protocol version HyBi 00, including request validation, header processing, challenge response, and handshake response.

methods.name: do_handshake
methods.description: Performs the WebSocket handshake, setting handshake attributes and sending response.

methods.name: _set_resource
methods.description: Sets the resource URI for the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: _set_subprotocol
methods.description: Validates and sets the WebSocket subprotocol.

methods.name: _set_location
methods.description: Builds and sets the WebSocket location URL.

methods.name: _set_protocol_version
methods.description: Validates and sets the WebSocket protocol version.

methods.name: _set_challenge_response
methods.description: Generates and sets the challenge response MD5 hash.

methods.name: _get_key_value
methods.description: Extracts and validates key values from headers for challenge computation.

methods.name: _get_challenge
methods.description: Constructs the challenge string from keys and connection data.

methods.name: _send_handshake
methods.description: Sends the handshake response to the client.
